title: Publishing Briefs: Drake ‘Iceman’ Collaborator London Cyr Signs With Electric Feel/Sony
summary: UMPG Nashville and ONE4 music form a joint venture, Quinn XCII signs with Prescription Songs and more publishing news.
contentText:
London Cyr, the producer who’s worked with Drake, Travis Scott, Don Toliver and Doja Cat, has signed a publishing deal with Electric Feel Publishing in partnership with Sony Music Publishing. Cyr recently produced seven tracks on Drake’s Iceman , and he contributed to Habibti .

“I am happy and blessed to be with Electric Feel and Sony Music Publishing,” Cyr said in a statement. “I have looked up to Austin Rosen’s approach to the music business for a long time, and I’m excited to work alongside both teams. I believe that together we can build something really special.”

Cyr’s collaborations on Iceman include “Whisper My Name,” “National Treasures,” “Plot Twist,” “B’s On The Table,” “Burning Bridges,” “What Did I Miss?” and “Little Birdie,” and he also contributed to Habibti ’s “Gen 5.” Cyr’s collaborations with Drake date back to 2024, when he worked on 100 Gigs and $ome $exy $ongs 4 U.

Austin Rosen , founder and CEO of Electric Feel Publishing, said, “We’re thrilled to welcome London Cyr to Electric Feel Publishing. London is an exceptional producer with a unique creative vision. We’re excited to partner with him and Sony Music Publishing as he continues to grow and achieve even greater success.”

Ari Gelaw , vp of creative at Sony Music Publishing, added, “Cyr is a true visionary, whose influence on hip-hop culture is undeniable. His ability to consistently craft sonically innovative and globally resonant records sets him apart as a key voice of his generation. We’re excited to partner with Electric Feel for this next chapter of his career and look forward to supporting his continued impact on the culture.”
